summary: Team TS3012 has settled on developing a yellow, curved, rubber-cased universal remote control for younger consumers under 40, featuring normal push-buttons, a deluxe LCD screen with an advanced chip, regular batteries, speech recognition, and a beep-and-flash recovery feature, while excluding removable covers from the basic design. For the final meeting, the team still needs to resolve five open disagreements (LCD screen placement, channel and mute button placement, a talking-back speaker, speech microphone placement, and a twelfth keypad button), decide on pending proposals such as a menu button and Chiquita sponsorship, and confirm production costs (since no finance data was available in TS3012c) against the 12.5 Euro target. Ahead of the meeting, B (user interface designer) and C (industrial designer) are collaborating on the internal and external design, D (marketing) is conducting a market analysis, A (project manager) is preparing the year-end project report, and all members need to propose a product name.
